description: Source code for a class 'Replicate' that extends an LLM class, implementing methods for calling and streaming responses from the Replicate API, including dynamic import handling and input preparation.

classes.name: Replicate
classes.description: A class extending LLM to interface with the Replicate API, supporting prompt-based calls and streaming responses.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Executes the prompt using the replicate model and returns the output as a string.

methods.name: _streamResponseChunks
methods.description: Streams response chunks from the replicate model, yielding GenerationChunk objects.

methods.name: imports
methods.description: Dynamically imports the 'replicate' module, throwing an error if not installed.

methods.name: _prepareReplicate
methods.description: Prepares and returns a replicate instance with authentication.

methods.name: _getReplicateInput
methods.description: Prepares the input object for replicate run, determining the prompt key based on model schema.
